request.description:
**Purpose:** Exchange a refresh token (from login) for a NEW access + refresh pair. The used refresh token is revoked — one-time use (rotation). Public: works with an expired access token; throttled at the gateway.

Failures follow the Sanaad convention: HTTP 200 with `{"status":"error","message":...}`.

**Purpose:** Revoke the current access token (bearer) and, when sent in the body, the refresh token — the pair is then fully dead. Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` (collection-level auth). NOTE: revocation is in-memory — a backend restart forgets it (tokens then live until natural expiry).
